scope: Quarterly aggregate research benchmark; shared policy and labor-flow functions. Does not run or validate the spatial world, banks, GDP ledger or wage bargaining.
informationSet: Revised historical series. Calibrate 1960Q1–1969Q4; common observed origin 1969Q4; score 64 unreinitialized quarters 1970Q1–1985Q4.
interpretation: Recorded policy and energy paths are conditional inputs, not forecasts or identified exogenous shocks. The inflation-target rule is a modern counterfactual, not the historical Fed regime.

data.vintage: Latest revised observations at retrieval; not a real-time information set.
data.method: Date/value rows from official FRED table pages, normalized to CSV. Direct CSV download timed out; table pages were retrieved through web browsing.

series.units: billions of chained 2017 dollars, SA annual rate
percent of civilian labor force, seasonally adjusted
percent per year, effective federal funds rate
thousands, civilian labor force age 16+, seasonally adjusted
index 1982=100, domestic crude petroleum PPI, not seasonally adjusted

baseline.method: 1969Q4 unemployment and annual inflation persist; GDP grows at mean 1960s quarterly log growth.

evaluation.rule: Historical qualification requires lower holdout RMSE than the locked-origin baseline on growth, inflation and unemployment; accounting and causal-sign tests alone are insufficient.

events.label: 1978–79 oil shock and subsequent price rise
